comparedFields: every serialized statistic and fitness field in every generation row
scenarioOrder: verified all 4,512 calls: 16 candidates in population order, each on original/technical/fast-oval track order, with the recorded generation/track seed formula and exact initial conditions
rng: same seed-2028 xorshift stream replayed from initialization; full uint32 state retained in the continuation checkpoint

protocol.trainingScenarioSeedFormula: uint32(trainingSeed * 65537 + generation * 313 + trackIndex * 7919); same scenario suite for all candidates within a generation.
protocol.fitnessDefinition: Per-circuit performance = 0.65 * normalized existing reward per 100 m (fixed lap bonus removed) + 0.35 * physical score; physical score combines capped normalized progress (0.30), completed-lap indicator (0.35), normalized pace (0.20), on-track fraction (0.15). Candidate fitness = 0.40 * mean circuit performance + 0.40 * worst circuit performance + 20 * circuit success rate - 3 * mean off-track events per normalized circuit distance.
